decided: Orbit trusts the branch checks made when the change was proposed, which the cited requirement applies and which refuse a pull request branch named like the main branch. At each later commit it re-checks only when the repository itself knows which branch is the main one, as a cloned repository does and one whose remote was added by hand does not, and otherwise commits.
alternatives: refuse to commit whenever the main branch cannot be confirmed, which would stop committing in every repository whose remote was added by hand
why: The branch was already checked against the main branch's name when it was made, so the only miss left is a main branch renamed to this branch's name since, which is rare and is stated as a known limit.

relies_on.title: `orbit pr select` computes propose's branch selection
